items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I have an album, a vinyl album of Bucky Pizzarelli with a group of other guitar players doing arrangements of Bix Beiderbecke’s piano pieces, “In a Mist.”

ctx.x: Well your career reminds me of Bucky Pizzarelli, who I’ve got to know fairly well. And what’s next, what’s tomorrow.
I have an album, a vinyl album of Bucky Pizzarelli with a group of other guitar players doing arrangements of Bix Beiderbecke’s piano pieces, “In a Mist.”
Well just a couple more things before we wrap up. I wondered, do you recall the most difficult studio experience you ever had? Did they ever have to do a retake because of you?
